name: selector_by_its_italian_name
why: W3.1-bis.5, decision D4: a selector of the bench written with its names of before the rename (`@faccia(verso=davanti)`) picks the face of `@face(normal=front)`. The bench reads it through the dictionary of the library and lists it in measurements.deprecated of the step. Removed in W3.1-bis.11 with the aliases.
defect_caught: A case of before the rename that stops resolving its selectors (a bench error, not a red), or one that picks another face in silence.

expect.tolerance_why: the diameter is read from CylinderParams
57600 minus pi*5^2*8: the count has pi in it
